title: This Year in History: Coca-Cola Consolidated Enhances Product Distribution with Vertique
summary: Explore how Coca-Cola Consolidated’s first Vertique installation in 2008 marked a milestone in the evolution of its warehouse operations.
body_markdown:
In 2008, Coca-Cola Consolidated installed its first Vertique automated warehouse system in Charlotte, transforming how customer orders are built and prepared for delivery. Since then, the technology has expanded to facilities across our territory, helping our Teammates handle volume more efficiently and accurately through a collaborative approach.
